title: Linux container process-bootstrap contract
goal: Make the setsid dependency explicit and prove it in the shipped application image.

tasks.description: Prefer adding util-linux explicitly to the runtime image unless a native bootstrap is implemented within this bounded task.
Extend Docker validation to require the declared dependency or its native replacement.
Build the final app image in package mode.
Run command -v setsid inside the runtime image.
Run one disposable app+PostgreSQL health smoke and teardown.
Do not add desktop capability to the LinuxHeadless profile.
